{{Quote|Welcome aboard, Agent Kallus. The rebels are headed to the brig, where quite the surprise awaits.|The officer to Agent Kallus|<ref name="Spark of Rebellion" />}}
A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] '''officer''' served as a [[captain]] aboard [[Transport 651]]. His ship was boarded by [[Spectres|rebels]] in order to [[Mission to free Wookiee prisoners|rescue]] [[Wookiee]] [[Slavery|slaves]], although it was a trap set by [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]]. The ship was captured by Kallus' [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]]. The officer greeted Kallus when he came aboard, and later joined Kallus on the Star Destroyer after the rebels destroyed the [[Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser|freighter]].<ref name="Spark of Rebellion" />

{{Char-stub}}
